item: Third sealed held-out readability/correctness suite; source and oracle models are private and never tracked

separation.policy: Development workers MUST NOT read .local/quality-heldout3/ (source, models, gold, inputs, outputs) nor run any decompiler on its inputs outside a measurement round. If breached, mark contaminated and retire; do not silently rename/reselect programs.

inputs_aggregate_rule: SHA256 of the UTF-8 text made of one "<cell id> <input sha256>\n" line per cell, sorted by cell id
libc_linkage: macho links -lSystem; elf/pe link a second object of the same private source built with H3_STUBS_ONLY that defines the four libc callees (strchr, strlen, memcpy, memset)
equal_access: Identical binary bytes and selected VA per pair; no source/debug sidecars/prototypes/annotation injection.
